Basic chat completion against real Google Gemini API

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["GEMINI_API_KEY"])
    req = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json('{"max_tokens":10,"messages":[{"content":"Say hello in exactly one word.","role":"user"}],"model":"gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite"}')
    result = await client.chat(req)
    print(result.choices)
    print(result.usage)

asyncio.run(main())
```
